subject: maths
question: A wholesaler bought 30 kg of pulses at 30 per kg and 20 kg of a premium variety at 45 per kg. After mixing them, he sold the entire stock at 42 per kg. What was his total profit or loss in this venture?
solution:
**Given:**

Quantity of pulses bought at 30 per kg = 30 kg

Price per kg of pulses = 30

Quantity of premium variety bought at 45 per kg = 20 kg

Price per kg of premium variety = 45

Selling price per kg after mixing = 42

**Formula Used:**

Total cost price = (Quantity × Price per kg) + (Quantity × Price per kg)

Total selling price = Total quantity × Selling price per kg

Profit/Loss = Total selling price - Total cost price

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total cost price = (30 × 30) + (20 × 45)

⇒ Total cost price = 900 + 900

⇒ Total cost price = 1800

⇒ Total selling price = (30 + 20) × 42

⇒ Total selling price = 50 × 42

⇒ Total selling price = 2100

⇒ Profit = Total selling price - Total cost price

⇒ Profit = 2100 - 1800

⇒ Profit = 300

**∴ The correct answer is Profit of 300.**
